items.title: AfD wins Saxony-Anhalt election with ~44%, first far-right state win since WWII still blocked by firewall
items.title_zh: AfD萨克森-安哈尔特州选举约44%居首：战后极右首次问鼎州级仍受防火墙阻隔
items.summary_zh: 9月6日萨克森-安哈尔特州选举出口民调显示，德国选择党（AfD）以约44%得票率大幅领先基民盟（约18.5%），创下二战以来极右政党在德国州级选举的最大胜利；高投票率约75%。州支部被国内情报机关列为“右翼极端”，主流政党坚持“防火墙”拒绝联合执政，AfD亦未取得绝对多数。共领Alice Weidel宣称获“明确执政授权”；州总理候选人Ulrich Siegmund称将向各方伸出手。BSW是否过5%门槛成为组阁变数。结果加大对总理Friedrich Merz的压力。

quotes.author: Alice Weidel / AfD
quotes.en: We have received a very clear mandate to govern here.
quotes.zh: 我们在这里获得了非常明确的执政授权。

items.fetch_notes: NM首页curl 429；WebFetch抓到significance列表估分6.3；据Politico/AFP/Guardian公开报道

items.title: Cloud in a Bottle: making self-hosting accessible to everyone
items.title_zh: 瓶中云：让自建托管对所有人可及
items.summary_zh: Cloud in a Bottle项目声称把云厂商打包的部署、鉴权与容器体验压成可自托管的形态，HN约601赞。支持者痛批AWS二十年定义部署范式；反对者指出维护者在他人仓库刷issue推广却不披露关联。自建可及性与推广伦理同框出现。

quotes.author: jiaosdjf
quotes.en: The cloud space is absurd, we've sat by for 2 decades while the likes of AWS define every aspect of deployment, auth, even containerisation. Containerisation was supposed to mean host anywhere, literally redeploy a complex set of services and their connections on any cloud provider at the drop of a hat. That is what a f**ing shipping container is, you rock up to any port in the world and the same container is lifted by any crane onto any ship or truck. Amazon, Google, Microsoft - these people have sold vendor lock-in to the very segment of tech society that should have been fighting it tooth and nail. 20 years ago you ftp'd some PHP files and it just worked, now you have to figure out 20 IAM profiles and shit your files across buckets because everything must be 1000000x scalable out of the box. No joke I was building a static firebase site the other day and just wanted a simple way to password protect it (like http auth) for staging so my client could see it - of all the useless shit firebase tries to lock you into they can't even do something as simple as basic http auth without a shit show and spinning up a cloud run instance or something to check a static password. Yes we 100% n
quotes.zh: 云这块太荒唐了——我们袖手旁观了二十年，让AWS之流定义部署、鉴权乃至容器化的方方面面。容器化本该意味着可移植与自由。

quotes.author: KomoD
quotes.en: These guys have been spamming issues in repos trying to promote this project and no disclosure whatsoever that they are associated with the project. https://github.com/search?q=%22cloudinabottle.toml%22&type=i...
quotes.zh: 这些人一直在各仓库刷issue推销这个项目，却完全不披露他们与项目有关联。

items.title: Pig-kidney xenotransplant bridges patient 271 days to human organ; field enters early clinical era
items.title_zh: 猪肾异种移植桥接271天至人肾：异种移植进入早期临床时代
items.summary_zh: Mass General Brigham在《柳叶刀》详述：基因编辑猪肾让终末期肾病患者Tim Andrews免透析存活271天，随后成功过渡到人肾，创在世受者最长免透析纪录，也是首次“桥接”至同种移植。早期T细胞排斥可治；晚期衰竭更多指向微血管/内皮损伤而非经典抗体排斥。eGenesis等多基因编辑猪与CD40/CD154共刺激阻断推动领域从概念验证进入早期临床；器官短缺危机下，耐久性与感染安全仍是下一关。

quotes.author: Dr Leonardo Riella / Mass General Brigham
quotes.en: We are in a crisis. We truly feel that xenotransplantation can be an alternative for patients who don't have a living donor where we could potentially bypass dialysis and get them to a transplant.
quotes.zh: 我们正处在危机中。我们真心认为，对没有活体供者的患者，异种移植可以成为替代方案——有望绕过透析、直接走到移植。

items.title: The revolt of the reader
items.title_zh: 读者的反叛：对抗生成文本的认知负荷
items.summary_zh: Bryan Cantrill式长文脉络下的“读者反叛”冲上首页（约564赞）：人们厌倦模板腔与AI生成散文带来的阅读压力。评论区一边引用Zinsser，一边吐槽检测工具Pangram连自定义域名邮箱都不让注册——反生成与工具门禁形成讽刺闭环。

quotes.author: kierangill
quotes.en: My revolt is against the cognitive stress of reading generated text. A trope typically indicates I’m in for an uphill read. I recently read this William Zinsser quote that inspired a nickname for this: Clotted Claude [1]. > Nobody has made the point better than George Orwell in his translation into modern bureaucratic fuzz of this famous verse from Ecclesiastes: > > I returned and saw under the sun, that the race is not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favor to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all. > Orwell's version goes: > > Objective consideration of contemporary phenomena compels the conclusion that success or failure in competitive activities exhibits no tendency to be commensurate with innate capacity, but that a considerable element of the unpredictable must invariably be taken into account. > First notice how the two passages look. The first one at the top invites us to read it. The words are short and have air around them; they convey the rhythms of human speech. The second one is clotted with long words. It tells us instantly that a ponderous mind is at work. We do
quotes.zh: 我的反叛针对的是阅读生成文本带来的认知压力。一旦出现套话，我就知道接下来会是一场上坡阅读。

quotes.author: kccqzy
quotes.en: I would love to use Pangram but they simply don’t allow signing up with my custom email domain. The error was “This email address can't be used for signup. Please use a different email.” I’m not about to create a Gmail is to use your service. To me the attack on the decentralized nature on Internet infrastructure is no less serious than the attack on the human provenance of writing itself.
quotes.zh: 我很想用Pangram，但他们根本不允许用我的自定义邮箱域名注册。报错是‘该邮箱不能用于注册’。

items.title: US and China plan mid-September AI safety dialogue ahead of Trump–Xi summit
items.title_zh: 美中筹备9月中旬AI安全对话：抢在特朗普—习近平峰会之前
items.summary_zh: 路透引述知情人士：美中拟在9月中旬举行特朗普第二任期首场专门AI安全双边对话，美方或由财长Scott Bessent牵头，议题包括联手监测AI驱动网络攻击、实验室风险信息共享。对话被视为9月24日华盛顿峰会可交付成果；白宫同时称“目前未安排AI会议”，议程与人选仍可变。中方媒体提出须共同定义“AI安全”、避免美方单边划界等前提。自主代理事故与跨境网络风险抬高紧迫性。

quotes.author: Reuters sources / planning brief
quotes.en: The talks, the first official bilateral discussions devoted exclusively to AI between the U.S. and China since Trump took office for a second time, will be led by U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent.
quotes.zh: 这将是特朗普第二任期以来美中首次专门聚焦AI的正式双边讨论，美方将由财政部长Scott Bessent牵头。

items.title: Chrome again exempts Google from user site data settings
items.title_zh: Chrome再次豁免谷歌自身：用户站点数据设置管不到自家
items.summary_zh: Chrome隐私控件再次被指对谷歌自有服务网开一面（约557赞）。评论尖锐：浏览器与恶意软件的韦恩图重叠越来越大；也有人追问为何大众仍默认Chrome。平台既当裁判又当运动员的老问题，换了一层“站点数据”皮肤。

quotes.author: liquid_thyme
quotes.en: Chrome may be an excellent browser, but the venn diagram overlap with malware keeps getting larger.
quotes.zh: Chrome也许是优秀浏览器，但它与恶意软件的韦恩图重叠越来越大。

quotes.author: MetroWind
quotes.en: I just don't understand why people keep using Chrome.
quotes.zh: 我就是不懂人们为什么还在用Chrome。

items.title: 128 countries agree non-binding text on lethal autonomous weapons in Geneva
items.title_zh: 日内瓦128国就致命自主武器达成非约束文本：为条约谈判铺路
items.summary_zh: 特定常规武器公约框架下，128国9月5日在日内瓦就致命自主武器系统（“杀手机器人”）定义与减害措施达成共识文本——十余年谈判后的政治突破，但非法律条约、全文尚未公开。美俄倾向本国指南而非有约束力国际规则，并在“人类判断”措辞上要求弹性；倡导团体批评文本被稀释。11月第七次审议大会将决定是否启动正式条约谈判。乌克兰、苏丹与中东冲突中的自主系统使用加剧紧迫感。

quotes.author: Tom Berendsen / Dutch Foreign Minister
quotes.en: Nearly 130 countries agreed on a text defining lethal autonomous weapons systems — a first step towards talks on a possible international treaty to regulate them.
quotes.zh: 近130个国家就致命自主武器系统的定义文本达成一致——这是迈向可能国际条约谈判的第一步。

items.title: A/I shuts down – Stay human
items.title_zh: A/I关停：Stay human——压力传导下的独立媒体夭折
items.summary_zh: A/I宣布关停并打出“Stay human”口号（约502赞、359评）。评论认为：再强调独立，一旦足够压力落到身边的人与基础设施上，项目仍可能被掐断；也有人把怒火指向政府定性。技术独立叙事撞上现实胁迫。

quotes.author: unfocso
quotes.en: Really sad, and also a testament of the fact that as much as we think we try to be indipendent, eventually once somebody starts putting enough pressure on the people around you (and you turn from "a neutral customer" to "a liability") the path to isolation is very short.
quotes.zh: 真的很难过，也证明了：尽管我们自以为在努力独立，一旦有人对你周围的人施加足够压力，事情就可能被扳倒。

quotes.author: InsideOutSanta
quotes.en: I hereby designate the US government an international terrorist organization.
quotes.zh: 我特此把美国政府指定为国际恐怖组织。

items.title: Germany plans national anti-sabotage shield and Cyberdome after Leipzig airport drone attack
items.title_zh: 莱比锡机场无人机袭击后：德国规划全国反破坏盾与Cyberdome
items.summary_zh: 内政部长Alexander Dobrindt对Bild称，俄方混合攻击已成“日常现实”。计划在柏林、慕尼黑、汉堡等九大城市部署可快速出动的联邦反无人机部队，覆盖机场、车站与政府区；并搭建Cyberdome传感器网络侦测拦截黑客攻击，考虑授权关键基础设施企业主动探测与反制无人机。背景是8月4日莱比锡/哈雷机场爆炸无人机事件，柏林已归咎莫斯科并关闭部分俄领事文化设施。立法、预算与指挥链仍是蓝图落地关键。

quotes.author: Alexander Dobrindt / Interior Minister
quotes.en: These attacks will increase, but we can defend ourselves and protect ourselves.
quotes.zh: 这些攻击还会增加，但我们能够自卫、保护自己。

items.title: Your intellectual fly is open (2025)
items.title_zh: 你的智识裤链没拉上：用LLM代笔的披露与思考问题
items.summary_zh: 2025年旧文翻红（约492赞）：类比“裤子拉链未拉”谈公开场合使用LLM写作却不披露。高赞评论强调“写作即思考”；也有人怀疑“因写得差才要披露”的论证——若模型写得更好，披露伦理是否仍成立。礼貌、认知外包与署名责任缠在一起。

quotes.author: jeremyjh
quotes.en: These are all important points and I love the analogy. But there is an even bigger issue with having LLMs write for you: Writing is thinking. Thinking and deciding. There have been many times when I start out writing something substantial - could be an email, a blog post, a software design document, anything - when my own views substantially changed during the writing process. Writing forces you to serialize your thoughts - and you can't always trust the gestalt. Reviewing gives you the chance to ensure the arguments connect solidly, that references are accurate (even informal references) and gives you the time to consider counter-arguments you aren't addressing. None of this matters much on LinkedIn, but it matters a lot in our work. You cannot outsource your understanding to AI. They are powerful tools but they do not have any human understanding - that isn't their optimization target.
quotes.zh: 这些都很重要，类比也妙。但让LLM替你写还有更大的问题：写作即思考，即做决定。

quotes.author: dynm
quotes.en: I'm a bit skeptical of arguments of the form, "You should not use LLMs without disclosure because LLMs at bad at writing." My reasoning is: If LLMs get better at writing—which I think is extremely likely—will you switch positions and say that now using LLMs without disclosure is A-OK? Surely some people are willing to bite that bullet and say yes. But for most people, my guess is that the answer will remain no. Thus, I tend to think that the "real" reason most of us don't like it when people use LLMs to write without disclosure is that it's misleading: It's a sort of a claim that certain thoughts can be attributed to a human being when in fact they can't. (The em dashes in this message were rendered using keyboard shortcuts.)
quotes.zh: 我对这类论证有点怀疑：‘不披露就不该用LLM，因为LLM写得差。’若LLM写得更好——我认为会——那披露义务还靠什么支撑？
